twilioHowTo: How to set up free Twilio SMS
twilioStep1: Sign up free at twilio.com/try-twilio and get a trial phone number.
twilioStep2: Copy Account SID, Auth Token and the phone number into .env (TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER) and set SMS_MODE=auto.
twilioStep3: In the Twilio console open Phone Numbers → Verified Caller IDs and add each demo farmer's mobile number.
twilioStep4: Restart AgriQNet (Ctrl+C, then npm run dev) and press Send test SMS here.
